items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Red Island wasn't living very far from my cousin of mine up in the Bronx. But I didn't see him.

ctx.x: You can see Red Island up there, huh?
Well I, Red Island wasn't living very far from my cousin of mine up in the Bronx. But I didn't see him. You don't know his father. I knew him. Allen. Henry Allen. I knew old man Allen.
I know Henry Allen. I used to follow his generals.
